name: Regular Planning Commission Meeting
agenda_text:
CHAIRPERSON MANALO

  VICE CHAIR DIAZ | COMMISSIONER FONSECA

  COMMISSIONER BARCELOS | COMMISSIONER PALHINHA

  CITY OF ARTESIA
  SPECIAL PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING

  TUESDAY, AUGUST 20, 2024 | 7:00 p.m.

  PRIMARY LOCATION

  Artesia Park Community Center Room A
  18750 Clarkdale Avenue
  (562) 865-6262

  AGENDA ITEMS
1.  Call to Order

2.  Invocation

3.  Pledge of Allegiance

4.  Roll Call of Commission

5.  Approval of Agenda

6.  Announcement of Speaker Slips

  For record keeping purposes, if you wish to make a statement regarding any item
  on the agenda, please complete a Speaker Slip located in the lobby or at the
  podium and deposit it with the Community Development Director prior to the
  commencement of the meeting. Please note that there is a five-minute time limit
  per speaker imposed. Please stay within this time limit.

7.  Public Comments for Items Not on the Agenda

8.  Consent Calendar Item

  A.  APPROVAL OF PLANNING COMMISSION MINUTES (FROM JUNE 19,
  2018 TO JUNE 18, 2019)
  ATTACHMENT

9.  New Business – Non-Public Hearing (None)

  1
 10.  New Business – Public Hearing

  A.  Case No. 2024-15/RESOLUTION NO. 2024-10P (CODE AMENDMENT) &
  RESOLUTION NO. 2024-12 (DESIGN REVIEW): The Planning
  Commission will 1) Consider and provide a recommendation to the City
  Council to amend the boundary of the parking in-lieu fee and parking
  operation and maintenance fee for new restaurants and restaurants
  expansion in the Old Downtown area; 2) Review a request for Design
  Review approval for exterior façade improvements to the existing
  commercial tenant suite(s) for Jay Bharat Restaurant located within the
  Commercial General (C-G) Zone at 18701 Pioneer Boulevard; and 3)
  making a determination of CEQA Categorically Exemption pursuant to
  Section 15301, Class 1 Existing Facilities.
  STAFF REPORT  ATTACHMENT

  B.  Case No. 2024-19/RESOLUTION NO. 2024-11P: The Planning
  Commission will consider Resolution No. 2024-11P a request for approval
  for two Design Review applications 1) Exterior and interior tenant
  improvements for Starbucks, which includes a 61 square feet addition to an
  existing 2,314 square feet commercial storefront located at 11732 Artesia
  Boulevard; 2) Comprehensive Sign Program located within the Artesia
  Boulevard Corridor Specific Plan (ABCSP) at the same address; and 3)
  making a determination of CEQA Categorically Exemption pursuant to
  Section 15301, Class 1 Existing Facilities.
  STAFF REPORT  ATTACHMENT

11.  Discussion/Report Items from Staff

  A. Update/Discussion Item Regarding Measure V Tax

  B. Update/Discussion Item Regarding Retail/Restaurant Items That Are
  Taxable Items and Which Are Not

12.  Community Development Director Updates

13.  Items from the Commission

14.  Adjournment to the Regular Planning Commission Meeting to be held on
  Tuesday, September 17, 2024, at 7:00 p.m., in the City Council Chambers of
  Artesia City Hall at 18747 Clarkdale Avenue, Artesia.
The City of Artesia complies with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990. If you require a disability-related
modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or services, please contact
the Planning Department at (562) 865-6262 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.
